description: What each Claude Code hook behaviour becomes on the other runtimes. `ported` runs the same shared decision; `equivalent` is a runtime-native hook covering the same need differently; `not-ported` has no counterpart, with the reason. Every safety behaviour and every handler in handlers.json appears once. Checked by the tests in the kit's source repository.

codex.note: Codex has no file-read hook; the decision runs on the shell command and the paths it names.

grok.note: A hook Grok stops at its timeout lets the call through, and so does a shell command carried under a field name the guard does not know.

pi.note: Pi lets a call run when an extension throws, so the extension catches every failure and blocks.

cursor.note: When Cursor also loads the Claude Code hooks, a per-command marker makes the check run once.

grok.note: Where Claude Code is installed too, Grok also runs the hooks in .claude/settings.json; both use the same per-command marker.

omp.where: .agents/meowkit/hooks/guard.cjs (hook module .omp/hooks/pre/meowkit.ts, tool_call on a shell command)
omp.note: With the claude provider left on, OMP also loads hook modules under .claude/hooks/pre; the kit has none there.

codex.reason: No SessionStart hook is registered in the Codex bundle; AGENTS.md carries the standing context.

cursor.note: A short pointer to .meowkit/ state, not the Claude Code orientation output.

grok.reason: Grok ignores the output of every event but PreToolUse; AGENTS.md carries the standing context.

pi.reason: No session-start text is injected; AGENTS.md carries the standing context.

omp.reason: No session-start text is injected; AGENTS.md carries the standing context.

pre-task-check.reason: Advisory check before Bash; no blocking effect.

build-verify.reason: Advisory build after an edit; the shared gates do not depend on it.

loop-detection.reason: Advisory; Cursor bounds runaway loops with loop_limit in hooks.json.

budget-tracker.reason: Cost telemetry; Cursor records tool events through telemetry-observers.cjs instead.

auto-checkpoint.reason: Session checkpointing is Claude Code session state.

learning-observer.reason: Cursor's telemetry-observers.cjs records afterFileEdit events; Codex has no observer hook in the bundle.

post-write.reason: Post-write scan runs after the write is saved: a blocked pattern fails the tool result (exit 2) so the model sees it, but nothing prevents or undoes the write; warnings are advisory.

review-evidence-tag.reason: Tags Claude Code review evidence; review evidence is produced in Claude Code.

post-session.reason: Cursor's telemetry-observers.cjs records sessionEnd; Codex has no Stop hook in the bundle.

pre-completion-check.reason: Opt-in. Codex: .codex/hooks/completion-check.cjs on Stop (block continues the turn). Cursor: stop-followup.cjs returns the same reason as followup_message. Both use lib/core/completion-check.cjs.

verification-evidence.reason: Codex: .codex/hooks/completion-check.cjs on PostToolUse Bash records a pass only when the result carries exit code 0. Cursor: completion-check.cjs on postToolUse Shell (success only).

orientation-ritual.reason: Claude Code session orientation; see safety.session-context.

project-context-loader.reason: Loads docs into Claude Code context; AGENTS.md and Cursor rules carry standing context.

jira-env-loader.reason: Optional integration setup for Claude Code sessions.

capability-bootstrap.reason: Codex receives the capability block in AGENTS.md at migrate time (capability-bootstrap-projection.ts).

safety-sentinel-inject.reason: Injects Claude Code prompt reminders; the runtime-native gates enforce instead.

nodeMissing.claude-code: Not probed. A registration whose `node` cannot start fails like any non-2 exit, which Claude Code treats as non-blocking.
nodeMissing.codex: Not probed. Codex documents exit 2 and the deny JSON as blocks; a spawn failure is not documented. Needs a maintainer run with node removed from PATH.
nodeMissing.cursor: Not probed. Every blocking registration sets failClosed: true, which Cursor documents as blocking on hook failure; confirm with node removed from PATH.
nodeMissing.grok: Not probed. Grok documents every hook failure but an explicit deny as fail-open, so a `node` that cannot start lets the call through.
nodeMissing.pi: Not probed. The extension runs `node` through `pi.exec` and blocks the call when it gets no answer, so a `node` that cannot start blocks every tool call.
nodeMissing.omp: Not probed. The hook module runs `node` through `pi.exec` and blocks the call when it gets no answer, so a `node` that cannot start blocks every tool call.
